To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
administration of ACTH prior to training is effective in alleviating extinction-induced performance deficits.

pretest administration (1) of ACTH alleviates performance deficits induced by prior extinction and (2) of dexamethsone prior to training eliminates the effectiveness of pretest administration of the peptide in alleviating performance decrements.

pretest administration (a) of ACTH alleviates extinction-induced performance deficits, (b) of ACTH does not alleviate performance deficits induced by dexamethasome, and (c) of ACTH is effective in subjects given saline prior training but ineffective in subjects given dextromethasone prior training.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of ACTH on memory processes.
the effects of ACTH on the retrieval of an extinguished memory.
the effects of endogenous ACTH on memory retrieval processes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
pretest administration ACTH alleviates deficits in avoidance responding caused by extinction only when ACTH is a part of the training memory.
pretest administration ACTH facilitates recovery of an extinguised avoidance response by acting on retrieval mechanisms rather than acting as a novel stimulus condition. (Author/DB)
ACTH is a necessary component of the training experience but not a sufficient condition for recovery of an extinguish avoidance response.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effects of pretest ACTH on an extinguished avoidance are dependent upon the availability of ACTH at training.
ACTH is not necessary for the formation of the original training memories but is necessary for the retrieval of these memories.

The main takeaway from our work is that
pretest administration is not a reliable way to induce recovery of an extinguised avoidance response.
pretest administration is a useful tool for studying retrieval processes.
the administration of ACTH is not a novel stimulus that disinhibits an extinguished response.
